raw_definitions: Definisi : 2. space available for those who wish to park vehicles, ruang letak kereta: there’s plenty of ~ behind the hotel, terdapat banyak ruang letak kereta di belakang hotel itu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. ( often attrib ) leaving a vehicle in a certain place for a time, meletakkan kereta: ~ is difficult in the city, sukar meletakkan kereta di bandar; a “No P~” sign has been put up, papan tanda “Dilarang Meletakkan Kereta” telah didirikan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
